The '''Splashdown restaurant''' was a restaurant that was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The restaurant was situated in the [[Greentree Pointe]] resort, near to the rollarcoaster ''[[Meteor Strike!!]]''.
